title: Side effects and what to do about them
body: The most commonly reported side effects are nausea, headache, dizziness, tiredness and trouble sleeping. Most are mild and settle within the first couple of weeks.
Report anything you notice in your check-in. If something is bothering you, we'll follow up and your provider may adjust your dose.
Some people feel briefly detached or 'floaty' for an hour or so after a dose. This is expected at treatment doses and passes on its own.
If you ever have chest pain, trouble breathing, a racing heart that won't settle, or you can't keep fluids down, treat that as urgent and seek medical care.
